observed_events.explanation: The branch no longer matched push.branches after codex/** was removed in e4b3f78.
The workflow declared pull_request with default activity types, but GitHub created no run.
The event is a default pull_request activity type, but GitHub created no run.
ready_for_review is not included in the default pull_request activity types.

root_cause: The closure commit removed the repository's deterministic exact-head push trigger for codex/** branches. The remaining pull_request route did not materialize a run for the observed GitHub events.
secondary_causes: pull_request event delivery or workflow scheduling did not materialize despite an active workflow on the base branch
ready_for_review was not an eligible default trigger
ci.yml did not expose workflow_dispatch for a manual exact-ref recovery

second_recovery.change: Expose workflow_dispatch on the existing quality workflow and dispatch it once on the exact PR head after push.

tradeoff.reliability: A direct push provides a deterministic exact-head validation route independent of pull_request event delivery.
tradeoff.github_cost: One additional quality run can occur when pull_request delivery also works.
tradeoff.push_pr_duplication: Possible; no manual run should be dispatched when an automatic exact-head run exists.
tradeoff.manual_rerun: Enabled only as the second and final recovery route after the restored codex/** push route produced no run.

proof: GitHub check suites for e4b3f78 contain no GitHub Actions suite
